name: VideoVault Premiere Extension
releaseNotes:
- September 8, 2026
- When the extension opens VideoVault Connect for you, it now stays completely out of the way — no window pops up over Premiere, it just starts quietly in the background, exactly like it does when your computer boots
- Clearer message when VideoVault Connect genuinely isn't installed and signed in on your computer yet, versus just not reachable right now
